links.comparator_used: LLM-only inference with no retrieved terminology evidence (and matched-concept masking)
links.outcome: Exact linking to the reference UMLS concept for known-concept spans (28 spans)
links.effect: Complete retrieval returned a reference-matched link for 28/28 spans (100%; 95% CI, 87.9%-100%). With masking, all 28 were assigned POSSIBLE_CANDIDATES. LLM-only inference assigned POSSIBLE_CANDIDATES to 25/28 (89.3%) and LINKED to 3/28 (10.7%). Decisions on the 28 unsuitable-extension spans were identical across all three conditions.
links.quote: In Study 2, complete retrieval returned a reference-matched link for 28/28 known-concept spans (100%; 95% CI, 87.9%-100%).

links.comparator_used: General-purpose Gemma and other models (SciBERT, sci_md, Llama 3.3) for clinical concept extraction
links.outcome: Embedding-match F1 for concept extraction against human annotation in 66 notes
links.effect: MedGemma 0.55 vs Gemma 0.53, sci_md and SciBERT 0.43 each, Llama 3.3 0.32. Exact-match F1 for all automated pipelines ranged from 0.07 to 0.17.
links.quote: embedding-match F1 was highest for MedGemma (0.55), followed by Gemma (0.53)

design_hint: retrieval grounding ablation (terminology evidence retrieval vs masking vs LLM-only)
